filename.description: Path to a file containing command-line arguments.

log_level.description: Log level verbosity. 0 disables logging, higher values enable more detail.

debug_options.description: List of key-value pairs to pass to the yaz library for debugging or configuration via -D flags.

debug_options.items.description: Flat item structure: name and value fields are keys in the map, but for a list of objects in Jinja2/JSON schema compliance, this defines the shape of items if it were an object. Since type is list, and we use a flat map description for items, we define the keys expected in each object in the list: 'name' (string) and 'value' (string). Note: Standard JSON schema for list items usually points to a schema definition. Here we describe the flat fields available in the list elements conceptually.

server_addr.description: Address of the remote ILL server to connect to.
